model: Siemens LMV36 burner management (Universal Gateway ProtoAir)
equipment_type: Boiler burner management system (LMV36) via ProtoAir gateway
applies_to: Thermal Solutions and Bryan boilers fired by a Siemens LMV36 burner management system, connected to the Universal Gateway (ProtoAir FPA-W44).
summary: A short profile for a Siemens LMV36 burner control read through the ProtoAir Universal Gateway on BACnet IP or BACnet MS/TP: flame signal, lockout and diagnostic codes, fuel selected and firing rate, plus writable control mode, operating mode and fuel rate.
notes: The table has no read/write column; AV and BV objects (N2 analog/digital outputs) are taken as writable.
The manual gives no units, ranges or state texts for this profile.

source.title: Universal Gateway Instruction Manual (ProtoAir): BACnet MS/TP, BACnet IP, N2, Modbus

integration.summary: Add the LMV36 as a profile in the ProtoAir Web Configurator with a unique Node-ID and discover it at 50000 + Node-ID. Read the firing rate, flame signal and lockout code; the BMS can set control mode, operating mode and fuel rate.

minimum_points.name: Fuel Rate
minimum_points.why: Firing rate command in remote mode

minimum_points.name: Com Status
minimum_points.why: Modbus link between ProtoAir and the LMV36

integration.enable: BV 4 Control Mode and AV 5 Operating Mode select how the LMV36 takes its demand; the manual does not list their values.
setup: Device instance = Node_Offset (default 50,000) + the controller's Node-ID (1-255), so Node-ID 1 gives 50001.
ProtoAir default IP address is 192.168.1.24, mask 255.255.255.0.
Add each controller as a profile in the ProtoAir Web Configurator and give it a unique Node-ID.
gotchas: No state texts are printed for Control Mode or Operating Mode; check the Siemens LMV3 documentation before writing them.
